# Infinite LLM Auto-Fallback Router + 9Router Patch Kit

> Zero-dependency multi-provider LLM auto-fallback proxy supporting SSE streaming, HTTP 429/529 cooldown failover, and a built-in Anthropic /v1/messages <-> OpenAI /v1/chat/completions translation bridge across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, and OpenRouter.

- **Repository:** https://github.com/jashory/infinite-llm-fallback-router
- **Interactive Playground:** https://jashory.github.io/infinite-llm-fallback-router/
- **Principal Author:** Scientist HM Shihabuddin Jashory (ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0003-4163-0092)
- **Research & QA Partner:** MD Rafiul Islam Shubho (Researcher, AI Evaluator & RLHF Specialist; Co-Founder & Managing Director, Vision Flow Group)
- **Organization:** Vision Flow Group (https://visionflowgroup.com)
- **Research Hub & Dossiers:** https://jashory.github.io/hqas8-autonomous-agentic-governance/researchers.html
